page.overview:
What is Attack on Abednedo?

After the Battle of Endor, the planet Abednedo was attacked by the Galactic Empire with a climate disruption array as part of Operation: Cinder. The planet was able to barely escape destruction due to local resistance and a New Republic special forces team.

As a result of the attack, many Abednedo supported the New Republic and Resistance.
